official_rules.description: The first phase of the 2-Step FTMO Challenge requires profit equal to ten percent of Initial Simulated Capital.
Verification requires profit equal to five percent of Initial Simulated Capital.
Equity may not drop below the CE(S)T midnight balance minus five percent of Initial Simulated Capital; equity includes open PnL, swaps, and commissions.
The 2-Step Maximum Loss limit is static at ten percent below Initial Simulated Capital.
Both evaluation phases require at least four CE(S)T days on which at least one position is newly opened.
The current 2-Step Evaluation has no maximum trading period.
The account balance must exceed the applicable target with all positions closed.
News restrictions do not apply during Evaluation and the published selected-news restriction does not apply to Swing FTMO Accounts.
Overnight and weekend holding restrictions do not apply during Evaluation or to Swing FTMO Accounts.
EAs are allowed subject to platform limits and the prohibition on server-hyperactive automation.
Strategies must remain replicable in real markets and must not use prohibited exploitation, overexposure, manipulation, or account-rolling practices.

internal_guardrails.description: Size all challenge positions from the immutable USD 100000 starting balance rather than growing or falling live equity.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Keeps live sizing faithful to fixed-risk backtest evidence and prevents risk creep while approaching the target.

internal_guardrails.description: Cap planned loss on any single trade or idea at one percent of initial balance.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Prevents a technical framework ceiling from becoming the campaign's target risk and avoids 4x or 8x leverage rescue logic.

internal_guardrails.description: Cap simultaneous planned stop risk for correlated symbols or mechanics.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Several sleeves can represent one economic trade even when their magic numbers differ.

internal_guardrails.description: Cap total simultaneous planned stop exposure across the challenge book.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Leaves material execution and gap room inside the official daily limit.

internal_guardrails.description: New entries require projected 99.9th-percentile daily loss to fit inside a three-percent internal budget.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Uses an evidence-based exposure budget while retaining a two-point buffer to the official five-percent daily limit.

internal_guardrails.description: Do not admit or continue a book whose modeled or observed total drawdown reaches seven percent.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Avoids repeating a loss-limit death and preserves room for unmodeled intratrade movement and execution costs.

internal_guardrails.description: Cancel pending orders and flatten the book after an equity target with a buffer; record success only after balance is above the official target and the book is flat.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Separates a conservative internal close trigger from FTMO's official balance-and-flat pass condition.

internal_guardrails.description: Use a smaller buffered target and lower risk in Verification while retaining the official balance-and-flat condition.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Verification has half the profit target with the same official loss limits, so it does not need Phase-1 risk.

internal_guardrails.description: Block new entries around the CE(S)T daily-loss reset while continuing to manage existing positions.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Avoids ambiguous exposure changes during the daily balance anchor and gives telemetry time to publish the new day state.

compensation_requirements: exact book-level mark-to-market and first-passage validation
FTMO-specific spread commission swap margin and symbol model
soft reason is not a universal hard-block dimension
evidence debt remains visible in the signed challenge dossier
free-trial execution validation before a paid challenge

evaluation_profile.objective: Pass the first FTMO 2-Step Swing Challenge with a rule-faithful book while preserving enough risk margin to complete Verification and operate the later Swing FTMO Account.

metrics.description: Probability of satisfying all Phase-1 objectives on a sealed, rule-faithful mark-to-market simulation.
Conditional probability of passing Verification after a Phase-1 pass with the lower-risk Phase-2 profile.
Probability of completing both phases rather than optimizing only the first purchase milestone.
Probability of breaching either official equity loss limit before completion.

go_criteria.description: Refresh and hash-bind the official FTMO rule snapshot shortly before any purchase decision.
Exact candidate binaries and sets have complete standalone-to-book entry, exit, timer, and ownership fidelity or an explicit predeclared adjudication.
Simulation uses tick- or event-complete interval minimum equity, Prague day anchors, FTMO symbols, costs, swap, margin, and pending-order state.
Phase-1 pass probability and its uncertainty satisfy the internal purchase threshold on a once-sealed holdout.
The upper uncertainty bound for any official loss-rule breach remains within the internal budget.
Verification and joint completion probabilities are decision-grade before buying Phase 1.
At least one exact-profile Free Trial or shadow run completes without a rule, governor, identity, or execution defect and remains inside preregistered prediction bands.
A paid Challenge requires a separate signed OWNER decision after all evidence criteria pass.

notes: This rulepack does not modify or configure QM_PropFirm, QM_FTMOGovernorPolicy, an EA, a terminal, or AutoTrading.
Swing news and weekend facts are provider rules; every numeric safety buffer and probability gate in internal_guardrails or evaluation_profile is QuantMechanica policy.
A future runtime integration requires a new reviewed version and explicit OWNER authorization.
